arguments.command: bd remember 'Meridian Credits release 1.0 credit agreement (approved by Finance in issue trial-9f6, 2026-09-07). Scope: monthly statement quotes; a request is the complete charge set of one independently quoted statement; caps apply within that set. Rules: (1) Each line'"'"'s uncapped credit is 10% of charge_cents, rounded down separately to integer cents. (2) A 2400-cent credit cap is shared by all lines with the same account_id, across its subscriptions; distinct account groups have independent caps. (3) Within a cap group, credit is assigned earliest service_on first; equal service dates use increasing line_id (Unicode code-point order). Each line receives its uncapped credit up to the group remaining cap; later lines get the remainder or zero. (4) Total credit is the sum of assigned line credits; a line'"'"'s amount_due_cents is charge minus assigned credit; total due is total charges minus total credit. Line invariants: exactly line_id, account_id, subscription_id, service_on (Gregorian YYYY-MM-DD, 2020-01-01..2099-12-31), charge_cents (nonnegative int, US cents); line_id unique within a request; subscription identified by (account_id, subscription_id); line collections may be empty. Release selection: omitted release selects the current agreement; an explicit supported release selects that version; versions remain supported once introduced. Commands: single-line quote (implemented in trial-9f6; response keys exactly release, line_id, credit_cents, amount_due_cents) and whole-statement total (implemented in trial-m30; request {"command":"total","lines":[LINE,...]} with optional release; response keys exactly release, credit_cents, amount_due_cents; reuses assign_credits_1_0 in main.py so the per-account cap spans the full statement rather than quoting lines independently; empty statement returns all zeros). Sources: issue trial-9f6 description (Finance-approved agreement), issue trial-m30 description and implementation.' --key 'meridian-credits/release-1.0-agreement' 2>&1
arguments.description: Revise the release 1.0 agreement memory with the total command
